verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own Batch Transfers capability for creating many transfers in bulk across countries, currencies and beneficiaries, for example payroll runs and supplier payments. That is a genuine first-party bulk operation, but the evidence shows bulk support only for transfers. Other objects such as cards, bills and expenses are described as programmatic or 'at scale' with no batch semantics shown. missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond payouts (e.g., bulk card issuance or bulk bill creation), evidence of bulk actions via CLI or AgentOS, batch size limits and error-handling details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Airwallex Batch Transfers allows you to create multiple transfers in bulk to streamline your transaction processing and reconciliation
Easily manage multiple transfers to recipients in various countries/regions and in various currencies to multiple beneficiaries for payroll runs and supplier payments.
